My Board is open source under the MIT License: github.com/yazinsai/audio-keyboard

Privacy: My Board sends nothing to Google or to ad or analytics services. Words, clips, chats and your dictionary stay on this phone. Voice audio, ✦ requests and chat summaries go only to the AI service you choose: Venice AI's private models, or your own server. Audio is deleted from this phone once transcribed.

Word lists: Leipzig Corpora Collection, CC BY 4.0, via HeliBoard's aosp-dictionaries.

Emoji data: Unicode emoji-test.txt and CLDR emoji annotations (English, Arabic), © Unicode, Inc., Unicode License v3.

Icons: Material Symbols and Material Icons by Google, Apache License 2.0.

AndroidX libraries and the Kotlin standard library: Apache License 2.0.

In WhatsApp and Messages, when they\'re on your list, My Board reads the visible chat when the keyboard opens and closes, and while you record a chat, and keeps it on this phone. In other apps it reads only the chat\'s name when you send a message, and the screen when you use ✦. When you open a remembered chat, My Board may draft replies from what it keeps on this phone; drafts go to the AI service chosen in My Board\'s settings. ✦ requests and chat summaries go to the AI service chosen in My Board\'s settings. A copy stays only in the debug log on this phone (the last 50 ✦ calls and chat summaries).
